name: Repeat Refill Rae
who: 44, has bought Northwick candles three times and gets the email when a new scent drops. Shops on the couch in the evening on Wi-Fi. Wants her favourite plus one new thing, and free shipping if she crosses a threshold.
voice_line: I already know I like these. Just show me the new scent, let me add my usual, and tell me what it costs to ship.
shopping_for: Her usual scent again plus the newest seasonal scent; she is trying to hit the free shipping amount without buying filler.

before_buying.need: the free shipping threshold or shipping cost
what the new scent smells like compared to the ones she knows
a way to add more than one candle easily

quits_when: She cannot work out what shipping will cost until the last step, so she cannot tell whether adding a second candle is worth it.
success_goal: Two candles in the cart and a clear total with shipping, from the email, in a few taps.
based_on: INFERRED, EXAMPLE ONLY (fictional store): no repeat-buyer data provided; built from the store's Shopify-style repeat rate note of 'about a quarter of customers reorder'
INFERRED: store FAQ says free shipping over $60 but the product page does not show it
